- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "A trusted engine support root under `${RUNNER_TEMP}/claude-engine-support`, staged from the verified workflow-support checkout."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml, "Resolve AI engine" step (validation-refresh.yml:91-120).
  Evidence of absence: validation-refresh.yml:111-112 sources `scripts/ai_engine.sh` and stages support from `${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}` (the dispatched ref). The LAST RUN DIFF adds a `checkout_head == GITHUB_SHA` check, but this is a tautology in normal operation — `actions/checkout@v5` (validation-refresh.yml:67-70) already checks out GITHUB_SHA, so `git rev-parse HEAD` always equals `${GITHUB_SHA}`. The check does not establish that the selected commit is from a protected default branch, and a `workflow_dispatch` on an unmerged same-repository branch with write access will still execute that branch's `scripts/ai_engine.sh`, local `.github/actions/install-claude` and `.github/actions/claude-pool-token` actions, and `scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py` with GH_PAT and OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The validate.yml workflow gets the verified-clone pattern right at validate.yml:285-309 by cloning from `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows` at the `stable`/`main` ref into `${RUNNER_TEMP}/codex-validate-helper-…/src` and using that as `VALIDATE_HELPER_STAGE_DIR`. validation-refresh.yml has no equivalent separate clone.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
